item.title: Bulletin updated at 17:20 HKT 18/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the outer subsiding air of Tropical Cyclone Wipha, the weather will be persistently very hot over Guangdong tomorrow. Thundery showers triggered by high temperatures will also affect the region. With Wipha edging closer to the Pearl River Estuary to the vicinity of the coast of western Guangdong and strengthening gradually, there will be frequent heavy squally showers and thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of South China Sea later on Saturday to Monday. Seas will be very rough with swells. Under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure, there will still be a few showers over the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week.

Date/Month: 19/07 (Saturday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, becoming north force 4 to 5, force 6 later.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Very hot with sunny periods during the day. Showers will be heavy with squally thunderstorms later. Seas will be rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 33 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
